signature_mechanic: Comfortable monotony: regenerating basic supplies make staying easy; lethargy and attachment gradually trap residents, who may vanish after a decade.
verticality: 290 floors via plentiful stairs and unreliable elevators; topmost floor receives Level 12 stairs; bottom floor stairs lead to L70/208.
